# WJ79 · Tools

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/tools`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Tools per Zalo account: switch each tool on or off; the model receives a tool only when both the account and its agent enable it. Settings for web search, web fetch, image reading and image drawing.

## Agent and care context
- Under `patient_channel` the image, video, document and web tools are off and show "Bị chặn bởi hồ sơ chính sách"; a patient who sends a photo is flagged to a person instead of being analysed (PLAN-AI01 section 5). The tools are ported, not deleted.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.tools`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Tools" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.tools`.

## Key actions
- Select an account
- Switch per tool (groups "Đọc & tra cứu" and "Hành động")
- "Settings" for web_search, web_fetch, read_image, create_image

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
